svg.title: THE HARSH TRUTH — latest RSS headlines

g.text: DeMellier expands retail footprint with debut London store opening ◆ Louis Vuitton names Hector Muelas chief brand creative officer ◆ Free People opens new FP Movement store in Cranston, Rhode Island ◆ Revolve expands retail presence with first Florida location at Aventura Mall ◆ Perfect Corp completes merger with ProjectNY and delists from NYSE ◆ Burton appoints former The North Face president Caroline Brown to board of directors ◆
